title: feat(calculator): compute customer invoice totals
description: Applies pricing discounts and computes invoice balance totals.

ground_truth.description: Operator precedence and arithmetic logic error in invoice discount calculation.
ground_truth.explanation: Calculates 'quantity - (discount * unit_price)' instead of '(quantity * unit_price) - discount', corrupting billing charges.

expected_evidence.description: Subtraction applied to unit count rather than calculated gross subtotal.
